text.tspan: sensorshow: temp fan PSU status
switchstatusshow: overall health
mapsdashboard --show
mapsdb --show for threshold breach detail
portshow slot/port: state speed credits
sfpshow slot/port: Rx Tx power levels
nsallshow: confirm WWN in name server
cfgshow + zoneshow: verify zone membership
fabricshow: domain IDs and principal switch
topologyshow: ISL topology
portstatsshow slot/port: error counters
portlogshow slot/port: FLOGI FLOGO RESET events
portbufshow: BB credit zero count
bottleneckmon --show: slow drain detection
Check hardware: fan replacement PSU swap
Escalate to Broadcom TAC for blade

g.text: Continue to errshow for software root cause

text.tspan: Review MAPS category: PORT ISL SWITCH FABRIC
Identify threshold breach and affected resource
Replace SFP or check cable loss budget
Test with sfpshow on remote port
porttest loopback: disable port first
Porttest PASS = HBA or cable issue
portloginshow: confirm FLOGI for this HBA WWN
alishow: confirm alias includes correct WWN
errshow for E_Port segmentation messages
Check domain ID conflict: switchshow on each switch
portstatsreset to baseline, recheck after 5 min
High CRC = cable or SFP; high Link Reset = HBA driver
Identify zero-credit port: portbufshow on suspect ports
Isolate slow-drain HBA: portdisable then monitor
Collect supportsave before and after replacement
Open Broadcom TAC case
supportsave -h scp-server -u user -d /backups/
Run on both switches in HA pair
